editorial.blurb: Newly opened Lemongrass Thai delivers bold, fresh flavors in a warm, cozy setting with generous portions and strong cocktails that won't break the bank.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the grilled squid as your highlight dish—reviewers rave it's smoky and perfectly charred—and don't miss their Iced Coffee, which is worth a solo trip on its own.

topDishes.note: Smoky, charred, and tender with balanced sauce—the standout highlight
High-quality thick meat with generous portions and sauce that's not overly sweet
